updates.text: An auditor's note indicates potential irregularities in the documentation for AeroPulse X1's active ISO 13485 quality certification.

policies.text: A vehicle receives commercial oversized haulage authorization when its maximum payload capacity equals or exceeds 10 metric tons.
Regulatory compliance for medical hardware is granted if an item possesses an active ISO 13485 quality certification or maintains a valid CE Mark certification.
A commercial fleet vehicle qualifies for urban low-emission access if its electric driving range exceeds 300 km.
An industrial storage facility receives class-A hazardous material clearance provided its emergency containment volume is at least 50 cubic meters.
A solar module earns green technology subsidies when its peak power output is at least 400 W.
An item meets health hardware criteria if it achieves regulatory compliance for medical hardware.
A medical device is added to the public healthcare index provided it meets health hardware criteria and holds a valid UL 60601 safety clearance.
